reason: Windows launcher scripts automate starting the local DSH web service, opening a supported browser, and cleaning up the service when the browser closes.

summaries.zh: 用于在 Windows 上启动本地 DSH Web 服务、打开浏览器并在退出时清理由脚本启动的服务。
summaries.en: A Windows launcher that starts the local DSH web service, opens it in a supported browser, and cleans up the service on exit.

capabilities: Starts a local DSH web service on 127.0.0.1:3080
Opens a Chrome or Edge browser window
Stops the service started by the script when the browser window closes
Stores DSH local data in a repository-relative data directory
